_meta.purpose: Numeric literals that collide with a tuning value but are genuinely not that constant.
_meta.rules: Every entry needs file, value and a written reason. An entry without a reason fails the gate, and so does an entry that no longer matches anything — an exemption must not outlive its reason.
_meta.granularity: An entry is keyed on (file, value), NOT on line, and matches on magnitude, so it covers both signs and every occurrence in that file. That is deliberate — a line-keyed entry goes stale on every edit above it — but it means an entry is a broader promise than it looks. Keep the file scope narrow.
_meta.warning: A growing allowlist means the gate is being worked around rather than obeyed. The count is printed on every run.
_meta.history: Held two entries during M0, both justifying coincidences in the inherited placeholder sim.gd (a 0.3 sound volume against pushDistance, and 1000.0 milliseconds against farClip). add-simulation-tick-core replaced that file and the staleness rule failed the suite until they were removed — the mechanism working as intended.

exemptions.reason: TICKS_PER_SECOND — the design document's Reference Tick section fixes the simulation at 60 ticks per second, and it is pinned in project.godot rather than tuned. The collision is with lighting.shadowVolumeExtent, which add-world-presentation-layer added and which is +/-60 wu of shadow volume: an unrelated quantity that happens to share a magnitude. Note what this shows — adding a value to tuning.json can make a gate fail in a file the change never touched, because the scan matches magnitudes, not meanings.

The hemisphere fill lights are aimed straight down and straight up: a quarter turn about X, in degrees. Geometry, not camera_and_hud.fovMax and not world.drivableExtent, which are the two constants that share the magnitude. Aiming them is load-bearing — design D2a records that the renderer spike once had both horizontal, tinting nothing.

CENTROID_MIN_OFFSET — how far the kart mesh's vertex centroid must sit from its bounding-box centre for the asymmetry to indicate which end is the nose. The supplied model measures 0.0764, so this is roughly a quarter of it: below this the mesh is too symmetric for the heuristic to speak and the test says so rather than reporting a coin flip as corroboration. The collision is with unnamed_in_spec.startFinishBandHeightY, the height the start/finish band floats above the ground — an unrelated quantity that happens to share a magnitude.

A bit shift in mulberry32 — `_state >> 15` — and part of the algorithm's definition, not a tuning value. Changing it would produce a different generator, which is why the file's own header warns that getting the masking wrong makes the sequence diverge silently. The collision is with prop_counts.treeCount, added by add-seeded-world-scatter.

The placeholder camera's look-at target on Z. A viewpoint, not a population: it is written down so the world scene's captures are reproducible, and add-chase-camera replaced it for the running game. The collision is with prop_counts.coneCount, added by add-seeded-world-scatter.
